execution.failure_detail: The frozen v1 numeric reader rejected a nonfinite value in an H2 concentration channel. The protocol did not predeclare a missing-value policy, so the run stopped without altering the reader or excluding the case.

claim_boundary: This retained negative result demonstrates that the v1 frozen intake contract was incomplete for real ELVHYS concentration files. It provides no alarm-performance, dispersion, detector-placement, consequence-distance or full-loop validation claim. The 12 downloaded tests may be used only for disclosed development and cannot be reused as a prospective holdout.
